exemplarMoves: Substitute generic nouns for world nouns only where the scene engine leans on them (wall, stones, lamps -> ward-stone, ward-lamp, slate plate).
Let the POV's trade filter the noun: Jaina hears currents, lattice, pulse; she does not read tactics.
Dialogue picks up local register through objects and posture between lines, never through lore in speech.
Ground exits in a physical thing (sign, hoof-ring, lamp) rather than abstraction.
Protect rhythm: prose is already fragment-and-turn; add by swapping a word, not by adding a paragraph.

openingThird.note: Cell, rack alcove, ward cutoff already carry ward-lamp, wall stone, slate plate, wedge anchor stone. Weak spots: 'hours' as counted time, 'stable' generic, unnamed Farstrider frame.

middleThird.note: Road, culvert, farms. Lordaeron-vs-Quel'Thalas contrast is under-played right after the ward cutoff (location notes require immediate contrast). One unsourced name ('Violet Gate').

finalThird.note: Fight and autopsy are well embodied. Final image of Millhaven ends on an abstract question; needs one world-bound exit anchor from the established village furniture (hanging sign, race, hooves on stone).

scenes.title: The Interrogation (B1-B6)
scenes.biggestGap: Room is anchored but unnamed in institution (Farstrider / post), the opening's 'hours' is counted time, and the stable/yard departure is thinner than the cell.

sceneContract.placeAnchor: One-chair cell, wall ward-stone behind her head, ward-lamp throwing white-blue, Cyndia at the threshold (all already on page; add Farstrider frame).
sceneContract.materialAnchor: Wedge anchor stone, slate plate, silver wire grip, satchel stockings and pebble, Thalassian mare, gate lamps.
sceneContract.povAnchor: Jaina hears currents and pulse through the staff and floor; reads Sylvanas by colours and rank, not tactics.
sceneContract.dialogueAnchor: Knuckles on knees, hands drawing lines in air, Sylvanas's palm by the stone, Cyndia pulling the anchor, staff haft passed over.
sceneContract.exitAnchor: Riding out under gate lamps and through the ward line; hum cutting off like a door slammed.

scenes.title: The Road to Millhaven (B7-B10)
scenes.biggestGap: The step from ward air to human air is felt only as the taste; the Lordaeron side needs an immediate smell/texture contrast with Eversong. 'Violet Gate' unsourced.

sceneContract.placeAnchor: Lordaeron border road: hedges, culvert and stream, farms with cold chimneys.
sceneContract.materialAnchor: Packed road under bare palm, frost fern on the ruts, tack creak, water skin.
sceneContract.povAnchor: Jaina sinks through road, clay, water, hedge roots, line (a mage's descent); explains with a river.
sceneContract.dialogueAnchor: Hands up between mare's ears, tack creak, mud sucking at hooves; Lyriel at the right knee.
sceneContract.exitAnchor: Staff humming, the road bending, the cow's bawl thinning behind.

scenes.title: The Wildlife Attack (B11-B13)
scenes.biggestGap: Final image closes on an abstract question; Millhaven's hanging sign, mill race and stone-ringing hooves are available but the last beat does not use them.

geography: Millhaven crossroads, mill, inn or tavern with hanging sign, stone bridge, thatched houses

sceneContract.placeAnchor: Open road at a holly wood bend; ditch; later the rise above Millhaven.
sceneContract.materialAnchor: Ice over the wolf's hind legs, antlers ploughing the road, steaming belly, red to the elbow.
sceneContract.povAnchor: Jaina sees only Sylvanas's calls and her own ice; reads liver, lungs, blood as a mage and anatomy student.
sceneContract.dialogueAnchor: Clear-calls roll; knife over knee; Neral soothing horses; Cyndia's 'Slowly' with Lyriel's fingers on string.
sceneContract.exitAnchor: Hooves ringing on stone toward dark houses, add the sign creaking on its bracket before the closing question.
